notes.title: Personal life Update, I have created a new game!
notes.content:
Hi guys, it's me Thomas.

Just a update on my life, if anyone is interested!

I'm doing well and I actually made a new game called "VR Dungeon Knight".

Some of you might remember that I did not make enough money from V ARRR, I simply could not pay the bills from it anymore.

I want to thank everyone so much who played this game. It was my first game ever and it helped me learn so much and get into the Game Industry.

I make games as a fulltime job now and it's all because of you guys! So thanks for supporting me and the game. I'm planning to make a lot more of them in the future ːsteamhappyː

If you want you can check out VR Dungeon Knight on steam, it's my new game and it's doing pretty well. I'm actually able to make a living from it.

Thanks for changing my life.
I wish you guys a great day!

-Thomas Blackjard Softworks.

notes.title: New update! Secret level!
notes.content:
First of all, a new shootout level is online and a secret level to be found. (I'm not telling where to find the secret, but... it has something to do with the number 50).

(do send a message when you find the secret level!)

I had some less time to work on the game this week, some things with family and hospital visits. But I will upload new content every week so don't worry!

That's all for now!
Have a nice day,

Thomas - Blackjard Softworks

notes.title: Saturday Update - New unlocks and more!
notes.content:
Yes, I'm still here and adding new things to the game every week!

This saturday will feature 2 new End game upgrades for your future in 
V ARRR!

(Other) Fixes or additions:

2 New Upgrades to buy
Replay the tutorial level
Button to wipe all your progress.
After you start hard mode, able to set the enemies to easy again.**
Sounds.
Particles
Animations.

**(Only the enemies are easy, you won't change prices, but you do earn less gold each day).

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Next Week: New levels to play and more.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I read all the suggestions and take feedback, but these things need time to be adjusted/made.

V ARRR is getting bigger everyday and features updates every week and some big additions in the future! Remember to suggest your Idea's too, I love to hear them.

Have a nice Weekend!

Thomas - Blackjard Softworks
